HELIOBIO THERAPEUTICS 2026 Proxy Statement
The Annual Meeting of Shareholders will be held on May 20, 2026.
The record date for voting is March 31, 2026.
Proposal 1: Election of two directors. Board recommendation: FOR.
Proposal 4: Approval of the 2026 Equity Incentive Plan to reserve 12,000,000 new shares, representing approximately 14.8% of outstanding shares. Board recommendation: FOR.
The requested share reserve is intended to support employee and director equity awards.
